title: GA/15/2011 of STATE OF UTTARAKHAND Vs NARENDRA AND ORS

paras.text:
GA No.15 of 2011
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Honíble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
 Mr. Amit Bhatt, Dy. Advocate General
for the State/appellant.
 Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate for the
Convicts/respondents.
In sequel to judgment dated
10.11.2017, the convicts namely Shivpal,
Jaipal and Pratap have been produced in the
Court by Sub Inspector Mr. Girish Chandra
Bhatt.
Heard learned counsel for the parties on
the quantum of sentence.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of
the convicts submits at the bar that a lenient
view may be taken in the present case taking
into consideration their age.
However, in view of all the facts and
circumstances of the case, the convicts
namely Shivpal, Jaipal and Pratap are
sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life
and to pay fine of Rs.10,000/- each under
Section 302/34 IPC and in default of
payment of fine, to undergo further six
months simple imprisonment. All the convicts
are also sentenced to undergo five years
rigorous imprisonment and to pay fine of
Rs.5,000/- each under Section 325/34 IPC
and in default of payment of fine, to undergo
further one monthís simple imprisonment. All
the convicts are further sentenced to undergo
six month rigorous imprisonment and to pay
fine of Rs.2,000/- each under Section 323/34
IPC and in default of payment of fine, to
undergo further 15 days simple
imprisonment.
All the sentences, awarded to the
convicts, shall run concurrently.

Registry is directed to prepare jail
warrants accordingly.
Let certified copy of judgment dated
10.11.2017 as well as of this order be
provided to the each of the convicts free-of-cost during the course of the day.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) (Rajiv Sharma, J.)
 20.11.2017
 JKJ
